transport.independent_argument: For one-based entries m_{rs}, put b_{ri}=m_{r+1,i+1}. The order-preserving bijection e(i)=i+1 conjugates each tau on {0,1,2} to sigma=e tau e^{-1} on {1,2,3}. Inversion pairs correspond bijectively because both the source order and the image order are preserved. Hence sign(tau)=sign(sigma), and each monomial product over i<3 becomes the product over j=1,2,3 with exactly the same three entries. No published definition is erroneous here; interpreting i<3 as {1,2} contradicts its explicit matrix and natural-number definitions.

Relabeling changes neither the multilinearity nor the cancellation nor the trace. Later transport and density equivalences depend on those identities, not on a particular index origin.
